what_changed: WTI bounced to 92.9 and Brent is about 102-103 on US-Iran escalation (a third carrier, China fuel export halt reports) and G7 reserve release talk, while XOM is still flat over 20 days. US yields hit a 24-year peak on a global bond rout and gold slipped to about 4,202. Micron beat estimates; the jobs report is due today.

oil_gas.why: XOM has not followed crude, the Iran headlines are priced in, and there is no dated catalyst.

gold_miners.why: Record-high yields and a firm dollar weigh on gold, with no concrete reason for a long.

chips.why: The Micron beat and the sector rally are already priced in and rates are a headwind.

pharma.why: The LLY approval is minor and drug-pricing policy is an overhang; no edge.

copper_uranium.why: FCX and uranium are weak with no clear catalyst; the China condition on the Anglo Teck merger is ambiguous.
